程序包 com.badlogic.gdx.graphics.g3d.particles.emitters

类 Emitter

java.lang.Object
com.badlogic.gdx.graphics.g3d.particles.ParticleControllerComponent
com.badlogic.gdx.graphics.g3d.particles.emitters.Emitter

直接已知子类:
RegularEmitter
public abstract class Emitter extends ParticleControllerComponent implements com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Json.Serializable
An Emitter is a ParticleControllerComponent which will handle the particles emission. It must update the percent to reflect the current percentage of the current emission cycle. It should consider minParticleCount and maxParticleCount to rule particle emission. It should notify the particle controller when particles are activated, killed, or when an emission cycle begins.
